predecessor: r1 was a deployment/interface smoke only, never fitted. r2 casts all likelihood inputs to FP64 and avoids accumulating CPU nice increments on restarts.
scope: Independent first-diagnosis time readouts over accepted frozen seed42 backbones. These are new time adaptations, not native time predictions or repairs to original result files.
target: Waiting days from the original clinical cut to the first subsequent diagnosis within ten years. Position strictly exceeds cut; same-day and repeated diagnoses are retained. This is not first clinical event, first-ever disease incidence, or a one-year horizon.
censoring: Observed first diagnosis is an event. Otherwise right-censor at min(3652.5, administrative followup minus cut), floored at zero. Zero-exposure censored windows supply no loss. Administrative followup is only a recording-availability proxy; death is not modelled as a competing risk.
input: Only diagnosis history through cut and its observed ages. Frozen native terminal representation plus six prefix-only covariates: log1p(history count), cut age/36525, log1p(time since last diagnosis), log1p(history span), log1p(median adjacent diagnosis gap), empty-history indicator. No future events, targets, administrative followup, or procedure/cancer/death token features.

partition.selection: Deterministic SHA256(seed, split, patient_index) ordering, fixed before fitting. Same patients for all five methods; no outcome-based selection.
partition.val: All original1000 validation cases, excluded from model-selection set
partition.test: All original1669 test cases, accessed separately per method only after validation integration acceptance and freezing that method's selected checkpoint

model.backbone: Accepted seed42, frozen eval mode, original vocabulary/context and terminal readout semantics
model.head: Train-feature standardization, Linear(width+6,64), GELU, Linear(64,2); separate trainable weights and normalization for every model
model.distribution: Z ~ Normal(mu,sigma), T=max(0,expm1(Z)); point mass at zero, continuous positive density, and right-censored survival likelihood. sigma=0.05+softplus(raw), capped at5 for numerical stability.
model.output: 20 independent keyed distribution draws per patient; draws beyond ten years are unavailable rather than clipped to the horizon. Also report a separately named deterministic median-time MAE on observed targets.

training.selection: Lowest censored validation NLL at steps100,200,...,1500; no test-based selection
training.objective: Per-patient mean negative log likelihood, including same-day mass and right censoring
training.precision: CPU FP32 representation and head; likelihood calculations FP64
training.recovery: Atomic immutable feature chunks; full head, optimizer, step, Python/NumPy/Torch and sampler RNG checkpoints; exact update replay gate

evaluation.primary: First-diagnosis time MAE in days: mean available-draw absolute error per patient, then mean over patients with observed truth and at least one within-window draw
evaluation.availability: Mean per-patient fraction of paired observed truth and within-window predictions over all cohort patients; also report patients with truth and with any paired draw
evaluation.secondary: Deterministic predicted median MAE on all observed first-diagnosis targets, separately labelled and never silently substituted for sampled MAE
evaluation.baseline: Training observed-target median with MAE on the same paired patients and on all observed-target patients; descriptive conditional-positive baseline, not a survival model
evaluation.acceptance: Source/weight identity, no-future-input gate, finite losses, exact resume replay, independent truth/censor reconstruction and metrics recomputation. Integration acceptance is not evidence of clinical superiority.
evaluation.comparison: Native A0/A2/Delphi/TCF numbers require their recorded availability and common paired patients for superiority claims. This release does not mix deterministic-median errors with native sampled errors or claim that original diagnosis generation acquired a clock.

shutdown: Detached remote supervisor and workers, closed stdin, remote logs, PID/starttime/boot identity checks and per-method locks. Local shutdown/SSH loss does not stop work. Remote shutdown requires relaunch and resumes committed chunks/checkpoints; computation cannot continue while the server is off.
limitations: Frozen retrospective cut conditions on future clinical-record availability. A20k training subset is a bounded first adaptation, not full-backbone retraining. Administrative censoring and a single lognormal family may be imperfect; retain real errors and availability even if model ranking changes.
registration: Fixed before this fitting, after earlier seed42 test aggregates were already known; not blinded preregistration. No ranking constraint or random perturbation of reported metrics.
privacy: Patient records, representations, checkpoints and predictions remain on the server. Only aggregate metrics, hashes and process receipts may be collected. No manuscript changes before result review.
